correctness.rationale: The actual reduced Świątkowski weight-three complex has dimensions (364,1326,1476,491). Independent reconstruction and full F3 elimination give ranks (363,957,491); the graph-cycle-surjective map on H1 and full rank of d3 give matching rational rank bounds rather than confusing finite-field rank with Q-rank, yielding Betti (1,6,28,0). Independently calculated all fifteen rational H2 class traces via the vertex/edge-orbit alternating chain generating function and H1 graph cycle character, matching the claimed class table. The original verify.py code was inspected for local differences, signed Koszul actions, boundary-square-zero and automorphism checks; the submitted proof gives exact Specht character inner products. The result makes no integral torsion or lattice-splitting assertion.
